name: Complex Eigenvalue Angle Irrationality
description: Replaces the Nim game with a condition on the top-right entry of a matrix power. The matrix is a scaled rotation. When x=y, the angle is pi/4, so a power that is a multiple of 8 yields a diagonal matrix (top-right is 0). When x != y for x, y in {1,2,3}, the angle is not a rational multiple of pi, so the top-right entry is never 0. This mathematically encodes x != y without any narrative bloat.
